title: GirishModuleManifest
description: Compile-time metadata specification for GIRISH platform modules.

id.description: Unique slug identifier for the module in kebab-case.

description.description: Brief description of the module purpose.

version.description: Semantic versioning string for the module code.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the manifest schema specification itself.

icon.description: Lucide icon identifier used by frontend navigators.

navGroup.description: Navigation category grouping for the module.

sortOrder.description: Default ordering index in navigation bars.

status.description: Default runtime activation status for newly reconciled modules.

visibility.description: Default visibility access tier for the module.

defaultAvatarThemeId.description: Default 3D avatar lobby theme identifier associated with this section.

routes.description: Frontend route definitions declared by this module.

icon.description: Optional specific icon override for this sub-route.

isExact.description: Whether the route matches exact URL paths.

requiresAuth.description: Whether accessing this route requires an authenticated owner session.

permission.description: Required authorization permission for this sub-route.

permissions.description: Permissions required or declared by this module.

featureFlags.description: Optional feature flag toggles specific to this module.
